title: Regularity descends along flat local homomorphisms
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings and $\varphi:R\to S$ a local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subseteq\mathfrak m_S$). If $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $S$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], then $R$ is a regular local ring.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00OF (lemma-flat-under-regular, line 27188) and its proof: a finite free resolution of the residue field kappa of R truncated at d = dim S, tensored with S (flatness), K_d tensor S finite free by Proposition Tag 00O7 (proposition-regular-finite-gl-dim) and Lemma Tag 00O5 (lemma-independent-resolution), K_d finite free by Lemma Tag 00O1 (lemma-finite-projective-descends), so kappa has finite projective dimension and R is regular by Proposition Tag 00OC (proposition-finite-gl-dim-regular, Serre)

proof.text: Lift R to ULift.{v} R and S to ULift.{u} S, both in universe max u v. Transport the local and Noetherian instances on R and regularity on S across ULift.ringEquiv. The lifted map RingHom.ulift phi is local by composition of local maps and is flat by RingHom.Flat.ulift_iff. Equip the lifted target with the algebra structure induced by this map and apply the already proved source-library theorem IsRegularLocalRing.of_flat (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Regular.ProjectiveDimension, Stacks 00OF). Finally transport regularity of the lifted source back to R by IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv. This uses the existing proof of 00OF, not any of the planned finite-resolution Sheaf statements.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 00OF and kept it; stmt_deps unchanged. Mathlib (LeanSearch, LeanFinder, Loogle, local search, grep) has no descent of IsRegularLocalRing along flat maps and no Serre characterisation, so the node is split following the Stacks proof in nine steps: finite free resolution of kappa (existing lem-weil-pbc-finite-free-resolution-noetherian, 00LP) truncated at d = dim S, with the case d = 0 (K = kappa) and the finiteness of K (Noetherian submodule leaf) written out; exactness after tensoring with S (Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-flat-tensor-exact); K tensor S projective by 00O7 (existing unsplit lem-weil-pbc-regular-local-finite-gl-dim) and 00O5 (new unsplit lem-weil-pbc-projective-resolution-kernel-projective); K finite free by 00O1 (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-descends-flat-local, a one-term composition of FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom, Flat.of_flat_tensorProduct and free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing); kappa of finite projective dimension; then 00OC (1) => (3) exactly as in lem-weil-pbc-finite-gl-dim-regular-local: pd kappa <= dim R (00OB node), dim m/m^2 <= pd (00OA node), Nakayama, definition. Stacks says 'K_d tensor S is finite free'; only projectivity is needed and used for 00O1.
